name: ReversalBarTailFraction
longCondition: el_ge(lowerTail, minTailFraction * barRange) && el_le(lowerTail, maxTailFraction * barRange) && el_le(upperTail, oppositeTailMax * barRange)
shortCondition: el_ge(upperTail, minTailFraction * barRange) && el_le(upperTail, maxTailFraction * barRange) && el_le(lowerTail, oppositeTailMax * barRange)
